Future<void> run(dynamic items, dynamic operation, int configured) async {
  const width = 1;
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, width, operation);
  final int limit = 1;
  // ok: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await pool.mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, limit: limit);
  var mutable = 1;
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, mutable, operation);
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, configured, operation, 1);
  // ruleid: serial-bounded-helper-dart
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, 1, operation, 4);
  await mapWithConcurrency(items, operation, 1);
}
